Metadata.title: PURGE — Reset a Windows PC
Metadata.description: A short, guided and readable Windows journey to clean up a computer and return it to the first-time setup screen.

Hero.lede: A short journey to check, confirm and reset Windows.

Use.summary: Four actions to take, in order.
Use.stepDownloadText: Download the package and extract it to a folder.
Use.stepLaunchText: Open Purge.cmd, then accept the UAC prompt.
Use.stepConfirmText: In the window, type exactly NETTOYER.
Use.stepResetText: In Windows, choose Reset this PC, then Remove everything.
Use.cleanData: Enable data cleaning if Windows offers it.

After.summary: PURGE stops before the next user’s setup.
After.restart: Windows applies the reset and restarts automatically.
After.initialScreen: The computer returns to the first Windows setup.
